problem_type: duplicate paid generation from split canvas/production ownership predicates
symptom: Canvas can offer or start a shot while its production attempt is unknown, reconciling, or awaiting durable confirmation.
direct_cause: productionShotOwnsGeneration derived ownership from display phase and omitted durable gate, current-attempt, and detached facts.
class_root: Canvas and production callers lacked one fail-closed durable claim decision over the Run ledger.
entry_points: canvas node ownership and batch eligibility
internal_only_reason: This invariant is internal durable Run state; no third-party behavior controls it.
invariants: A shot with an in-flight or reconcile-required current attempt remains production-owned.
A rejected/excluded/detached shot with no paid attempt is canvas-owned.
Canvas and production ask the same pure decision function.

door_reduction.why_not: The compatibility export and node adapter remain separate read/write doors while all decisions converge on decideShotClaim; the old implementation itself is removed.

generality_proof: The decision reads only durable Run plan, gate, shot, current-attempt job, run status, and detached facts, so every canvas caller using the adapter receives identical results regardless of display projection.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own the durable shot claim and fail closed for unknown/reconcile states.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Uses the same production-shot ownership adapter before dispatch.
Scheduler dispatch remains outside this canvas claim-only stage per task scope.

recurrence.reason: Multiple canvas entry points and durable job states can reproduce the split predicate; the report identified five independent state classes.
same_class_scan: matrix tests for unknown/reconciling, stopped, rejected, detached

prevention.invariant: Only durable claim facts decide whether canvas or production owns generation.
prevention.failure_mode: Unknown or reconcile-required attempts stay production-owned; missing identity returns none.
prevention.strategy: Replace the display-phase predicate with one pure shared decision and delete the old implementation.

legacy_paths.rationale: The display-derived ownership predicate is deleted from this changed module; phase derivation remains display-only.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls the claim invariant.

migration: No persisted schema migration is needed; legacy Runs are read with absent optional facts treated as no detached/excluded marker, while existing jobs remain durable evidence.
residual_risks: Production scheduler and beforeDispatch wiring remain B-stage work and are intentionally not changed in this task.
